name: ReturnToDatabaseOrResource
summary: The card component of Return to Database or Resource (DUO_0000029). It reads AgreementCredential and ComputeEnvironmentCredential: the agreement must be to the terms document its policy data names, and the compute environment must attest SecureHandlingOfResults. It decides about the requester.

requiredDocumentID.description: DID of the terms document the requester must accept. An AgreementCredential qualifies if claims.agreementInfo.documentID equals it.
